name: SalesPatriot
category: AOG support: parts, rotables and technicians
summary: On October 15, S&K Aerospace, which supports more than 100 partner nations and every U.S. military service, said it is deploying SalesPatriot's agentic AI across its MRO enterprise. The system captures each parts or repair requirement in whatever format it arrives and carries it through to a response ready for submission, with S&K experts approving at every decision.

whyItMatters: Requests arrive by email, portal and spreadsheet, and the slow part is turning each one into a quote. If an AI drafts the response and a buyer approves it, the same team can answer more requests the same day.
